murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.title: Murder on the Aurora Dawn
murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.tagline: A steampunk murder mystery adventure for 5th Edition
murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.hook: When the airship Aurora Dawn is three days from port, one of its wealthiest passengers turns up dead in a locked stateroom — and the killer is still aboard. Your party has until the ship docks to sort suspects from scapegoats, unravel motives tangled in old debts and older grudges, and catch a murderer before they slip away into the crowd at landing.
murder-on-the-aurora-dawn.quote: Everyone on this ship has a reason to want him dead. I'm just the only one honest enough to admit it.

the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.title: The Carnival of Forgotten Smiles
the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.tagline: Uncover the dark secrets behind a mysterious carnival in this thrilling one-shot for 5E.
the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.hook: A traveling carnival rolls into town overnight, its tents lit and its performers smiling — but the smiles never seem to move, and nobody in town remembers inviting it. When a local child goes missing after the opening show, your party has one night to find out what the carnival really is before it packs up and vanishes for good.
the-carnival-of-forgotten-smiles.quote: Step right up — everyone who walks through these gates gets exactly what they deserve.
